blocks.text: 我们很高兴宣布推出 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6，这是我们开源音频驱动数字人视频生成框架的最新升级版本。在 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 的基础上，1.6 版本提升了表现自然度、唇音同步、面部与身体动作的协调性，以及长视频生成过程中的视觉一致性。同时，该版本还引入了全面的推理优化，使部署更快、更高效。

inlines.text: 我们很高兴宣布推出 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6，这是我们开源音频驱动数字人视频生成框架的最新升级版本。在 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 的基础上，1.6 版本提升了表现自然度、唇音同步、面部与身体动作的协调性，以及长视频生成过程中的视觉一致性。同时，该版本还引入了全面的推理优化，使部署更快、更高效。
更自然、更稳定的唇部动画：
减少夸张或紧绷的嘴部动作、嘴唇过红以及嘴部区域的时间不稳定性。
：缓解自回归视频续写过程中的误差累积，可生成超过 10 分钟的视频，同时保持视觉质量、身份一致性和时间连贯性。
：通过端到端流水线和模型执行优化加速视频生成，实现更高效的部署与服务。

blocks.text: 我们将 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 与前代 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 以及四个商业系统 OmniHuman-2.0、HeyGen、OmniHuman-1.5 和 Kling Avatar 2.0 进行了对比。全配对人工偏好研究覆盖全部 15 组模型配对，共收集 33,051 张有效个人投票。在包含 33,051 张有效个人投票的人工偏好竞技场中，LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 在六个参评系统中排名第二。其 Bradley–Terry Elo 得分为 1068.1，排在 OmniHuman-2.0 之后，领先于 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5、HeyGen、OmniHuman-1.5 和 Kling Avatar 2.0。

blocks.text: We are excited to announce the release of LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, the latest upgrade to our open-source framework for audio-driven human video generation. Building upon LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5, 1.6 improves expressive naturalness, lip–audio synchronization, coordinated facial and body motion, and visual consistency during long-form generation. It also introduces comprehensive inference optimizations for faster and more efficient deployment.

inlines.text: We are excited to announce the release of LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, the latest upgrade to our open-source framework for audio-driven human video generation. Building upon LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5, 1.6 improves expressive naturalness, lip–audio synchronization, coordinated facial and body motion, and visual consistency during long-form generation. It also introduces comprehensive inference optimizations for faster and more efficient deployment.
More Natural and Stable Lip Animation:
: Reduces exaggerated or strained mouth movements, overly red lip coloration, and temporal instability in the mouth region.
: Mitigates error accumulation during autoregressive video continuation, enabling videos exceeding 10 minutes while preserving visual quality, identity consistency, and temporal coherence.
: Accelerates video generation through end-to-end pipeline and model execution optimizations, enabling more efficient deployment and serving.

blocks.text: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 delivers more natural lip movements and expressive motion while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency in videos exceeding 10 minutes.

blocks.text: We compare LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 with its predecessor LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 and four commercial systems: OmniHuman-2.0, HeyGen, OmniHuman-1.5, and Kling Avatar 2.0. The all-pairs human preference study comprises 33,051 valid individual votes across all 15 model pairings. LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 ranks second among six evaluated systems in a human preference Arena comprising 33,051 valid individual votes. With a Bradley–Terry Elo score of 1068.1, it ranks behind OmniHuman-2.0 and ahead of LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5, HeyGen, OmniHuman-1.5, and Kling Avatar 2.0.
